ceu: ✦ The sextile between the Sun and Saturn

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, friendships and your image: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
With Mars retrograde in your daily routine sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Talk with someone from another generation or another culture.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your career and your inner life: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Throw away something you keep only out of attachment.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your horizons and friendships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
With Mars retrograde in your home and family sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Own up to a mistake of yours in a relationship, without beating about the bush.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your career: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
With Mars retrograde in your communication sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Drink a glass of water as soon as you wake up.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, relationships and your horizons: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
With Mars retrograde in your money sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Play with a child or remember what it was like to play.

t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, routine and intimacy: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Mars retrograde in your self-image sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Have dinner without the television and talk with the people you live with.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, romance and relationships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
With Mars retrograde in your inner life sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Ask the question you are embarrassed to ask: the answer may surprise you.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, family and routine: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
With Mars retrograde in your friendship sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Before buying, wait twenty-four hours and see if you still want it.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, conversations and romance: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
With Mars retrograde in your career sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Write down three of your qualities and read them out loud.

t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, money and family: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Mars retrograde in your horizons sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Light some incense or a candle and breathe deeply.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your image and conversations: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Let things flow without forcing them.
With Mars retrograde in your intimacy sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Send a message to a friend you miss.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.

The sextile between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your inner life and money: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
With Mars retrograde in your relationships sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Update your CV or your professional profile.
